title: Making and Evaluating Point Forecasts

supported_claim: Point forecast evaluation must match the intended statistical functional or loss; different point targets answer different questions.
limitations: General decision-theoretic forecast evaluation; no enterprise AI-spend or finance-user validation. This note does not rely on the historical claim about standalone conditional value at risk.
